prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agent for every seller — the right agent depends on your property, price range, timeline, and what marketing/communication style you want. I can help you find the best fit. Below is a practical approach you can use right away.

Quick plan
1. Interview 3+ local agents who sell in Pleasanton (same neighborhood and price range).  
2. Compare their recent comparable sales, marketing plans, net sheets, and references.  
3. Choose the agent who shows the strongest results for homes like yours and who you trust to represent you.

Where to find candidates
- Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin agent profiles (filter by Pleasanton sold listings).  
- Local brokerage offices: Keller Williams Tri-Valley, Coldwell Banker, Compass, Intero, and local independent firms.  
- Nextdoor, Yelp, Facebook neighborhood groups and local community forums.  
- Ask neighbors who recently sold who they used and what their experience was.

What to compare (objective metrics)
- Recent closed sales in Pleasanton matching your price band (last 6–12 months).  
- List price vs. sale price (how close did their listings sell to ask?).  
- Average days on market for their listings.  
- Number of listings sold (sales volume) in your neighborhood/price range.  
- Client references and online reviews.

Key questions to ask each agent
1. How many homes like mine have you sold in Pleasanton in the last 12 months?  
2. Can you provide recent comps and a suggested listing price range, with rationale?  
3. What is your average list-to-sale price ratio and days on market?  
4. Can you provide 2–3 recent seller references I can call?  
5. What is your marketing plan (photos, virtual tours, staging, online ads, open houses, targeted buyer outreach)?  
6. Who will handle showings, negotiations, and escrow — you or your team?  
7. What professional photos, floor plans, and marketing materials do you include? Any extra costs?  
8. How will you communicate and how often? (phone/text/email, weekly updates)  
9. What’s your commission rate and are there any other fees?  
10. Do you provide a seller net sheet estimating proceeds after costs?  
11. How will you price and adjust if it doesn’t sell in X days?  
12. Have you sold properties in my HOA/neighborhood and handled HOA docs/requirements?  
13. How do you qualify and screen buyers/showings?  
14. What negotiation strategy will you use if multiple offers arrive?  
15. What are common issues you see in Pleasanton closings and how do you handle them?

Red flags
- Refuses to provide recent comparable sales or references.  
- Vague marketing plan or no professional photography.  
- Pressure to sign an exclusive long contract without answers to your questions.  
- No local sales in your neighborhood or price range.

Practical next steps I can help with
- If you give your address (or zip/neighborhood), price expectation, and timeline, I can:  
  - Draft a shortlist of questions tailored to your property.  
  - Provide a script/template to interview agents.  
  - Create a side-by-side comparison checklist to evaluate proposals.  
- I can also draft a message you can send to multiple agents requesting a CMA and marketing plan.

If you’d like, share your property details (address or neighborhood, home type, beds/baths, any recent upgrades, timeframe) and I’ll help you prepare targeted interview questions and what to look for in each agent’s CMA.
